purpose: Reconstruct what the founder operating environment must be able to do, stated independently of any product name, so that candidates can be judged against requirements rather than requirements being reverse-engineered from a named stack. The prior lane inverted this order and produced a halted install batch.

evidence_label_definitions.DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED: This lane executed a command against a live source and recorded the command, URL and fetch date. Raw output is under receipts/so02/2026-08-22/oe-l2-capability-research/raw/.
evidence_label_definitions.DOCUMENTED: Asserted by an official source that this lane fetched, where the assertion is about behaviour this lane did not itself execute.
evidence_label_definitions.HYPOTHESIS: Untested inference by this lane. Never sufficient for a recommendation.
